info.description: Boltzmann brains over REST: discovery, and the full lifecycle -- create, evidence, commits, branches, push/pull, converge, import -- over the service's working store. Lifecycle errors carry a stable `code`: `usage` (400), `not_found` (404), `refused_protocol` (422), `refused_policy` (403), `rejected_candidates` (422), `not_fast_forward` (409), `registry_unavailable` (502), `needs_human` (409), `internal` (500), `unauthenticated` (401). Long operations answer 202 with a job (`GET /v1/jobs/{id}`).
info.title: Gaussia Brains MCP Server

Return detail for a single brain.

counts, head, branches, any open convergence, and its publication, with

brain reports its published manifest.

*brain_ref* may be a short reference such as ``brains/my-brain:latest`` or a
full OCI reference such as ``registry.example.com/acme/handbook:main``.
Errors carry the lifecycle's stable ``code``.

post.description:
Migrate an existing brain into the working store (job).

``application/json`` (:class:`ImportRequest`) imports from the registry;
``multipart/form-data`` with a ``layout`` file (a ``.tar``/``.tar.gz`` of a
brain's OCI layout) imports an upload. Governed brains are imported as they
are and served read-only. An upload larger than ``GBMS_STORE_MAX_IMPORT_BYTES``
is ``usage`` (413); a new brain named with a reserved segment is ``usage``.
